value.rationale: The motivating work identifies the semistable grazing circle but not its convergence clock. Exact loss coefficients for asymmetric single versus simultaneous double grazing give a precise transient prediction and distinguish two structurally natural cases; the n^-2 approach rate is qualitatively different from exponential attraction and cannot be inferred from linearization.
